name: Shipper portal web UI
note: Static web UI served from any web server.

name: API gateway
note: Routes and authenticates calls inside the deployment boundary.

name: Exception triage service
note: The application logic built in Phase 2 style: rules, workflow, state.

name: Model inference via vendor API
note: Prompts carry shipment and customer data. A self-hosted open-weight model is a real alternative, at real cost.

name: Retrieval index over carrier documents
note: Local vector store over documents already inside the boundary.

name: Carrier rate feed ingestion
note: Pulls published carrier rate and surcharge feeds. The feed is external by definition; the data it carries is published, not regulated.

name: Cloud OCR for bills of lading
note: Bills of lading carry shipper, consignee and goods data. No self-hosted OCR of acceptable quality was found in discovery.

name: SaaS telemetry exporter
note: Exports timings and counts only. A local collector can replace the SaaS endpoint.

name: SaaS identity provider integration
note: The customer directory can be federated locally instead of calling the SaaS provider.

name: Vendor eval benchmark API
note: Eval cases are built from real shipment examples, so calling the vendor API sends regulated data out.

name: Automatic update service
note: Pulls application and model updates automatically. Sends no customer data; it is a reach-out, not a send-out.

name: Audit log store
note: Local append-only store. Its whole point is that it never leaves.
